name: manual_d1d4be
claim: Treat discovery, publication, review, and merge as separate authorizations. A discovery PR may carry a verified production fix, but save, commit, push, publish, or fix instructions do not authorize merging it; preserve PR-local provenance until explicit merge authorization is given.

decisions.notes: Separated from lesson_757476abb44e so PR-locality and non-merge discipline remain structured recall guidance after the authorization-only supersession.

rationale: Separated from lesson_757476abb44e so PR-locality and non-merge discipline remain structured recall guidance after the authorization-only supersession.
